phases.title: Evidence and host readiness
tasks: Refresh restricted ADB inventory; retain failures as evidence.
Check host tools and record versions; identify exact Android incremental build and RAM/storage SKU.
Keep device identity and stock facts separate from marketing and sibling assumptions.
deliverables: Private raw inventory with timestamp and hashes
phases.exit_gate: Identity lithium and current boot state corroborated; missing/denied reads recorded.

phases.title: Recovery baseline and stock artifacts
tasks: Locate exact lithium firmware matching the incremental build; verify provenance and digest.
Inventory boot/recovery partitions and sizes read-only; inspect boot headers, DTB placement and cmdline offline.
Confirm user-data backup and documented stock recovery path; never assume EDL is a usable fallback.
Record a concrete restore procedure and image hashes; do not run vendor flash-all scripts.
phases.exit_gate: Matching restoration artifacts and a reviewed recovery procedure exist before any boot experiment.

phases.title: Pin source and boot-path baselines
tasks: Pin Linux, pmaports and pmbootstrap revisions and inspect scorpio packages.
Compare shared MSM8996 support and lithium downstream source; build a component support matrix.
Audit lk2nd source targets and board matching; add lithium to the existing MSM8996 target from verified stock DTB IDs.
Build and inspect the lithium lk2nd image, then retain recovery as the selected first-stage path; do not flash a sibling image.
deliverables: Source lock JSON with full commits
phases.exit_gate: A supported or explicitly scoped experimental boot path and kernel baseline are chosen with evidence.

phases.title: Hardware map and minimal DTS
tasks: Extract DTB and panel evidence offline; retain source locations and hashes.
Map DRAM, reserved-memory, firmware carveouts, PSCI, interrupt controller, clocks, regulators, USB and storage.
Author lithium DTS against upstream bindings; enable only evidenced nodes.
Treat simple-framebuffer as bootloader-initialized scanout: verify address, size, stride, format, power retention and non-overlap.
Map TLMM separately from PMIC GPIO/MPP and PON keys; verify interrupts, polarity, bias and debounce.
phases.exit_gate: DTS compiles and applicable dtbs_check passes; every enabled node has traceable hardware evidence.

phases.title: Reproducible pmbootstrap packages
tasks: Use pinned pmaports conventions to generate device-xiaomi-lithium/APKBUILD and deviceinfo.
Prefer the verified shared MSM8996 kernel package; create a separate kernel package only if justified.
Set DTB name, architecture, image packing and flash metadata from the boot-layout audit.
Build a minimal rootfs with diagnostic shell and USB networking; record package checksums and build logs.
phases.exit_gate: Package lint and build pass; kernel/DTB/image fit verified constraints; no placeholder values remain.

phases.title: First recoverable native boot
tasks: Present exact image hashes, boot method, expected behavior and recovery steps before changing device state.
Prefer a validated temporary boot path; keep internal filesystems unmounted or read-only initially.
Capture early console, USB diagnostics or pstore where actually available.
Establish boot to shell and return to Android; investigate one failure at a time.
phases.exit_gate: Native Linux reaches a diagnostic shell and the tested recovery path restores normal operation.

phases.title: Display, input and essential power
tasks: Identify actual panel variant and parse complete downstream commands with transport metadata.
Implement panel supply/reset timing and DRM modes; simple framebuffer success does not prove native DSI support.
Enable touch and keys from verified bus/GPIO mappings; test full 1080x2040 input coordinates.
Validate battery reporting, charging, thermal limits and clean poweroff before sustained use.
phases.exit_gate: Stable display and input with monitored safe thermal and charging behavior.

phases.title: Connectivity and acceleration
tasks: Bring up Wi-Fi/Bluetooth with identified legally usable firmware and calibration data.
Validate GPU, audio, sensors and suspend/resume separately.
Treat modem, calls and cameras as independent later work; record unsupported features explicitly.
phases.exit_gate: Chosen usable-device feature set is repeatable; missing functions are documented.

phases.title: Reproducibility and upstream review
tasks: Rebuild from pinned sources on a clean host and compare artifacts where deterministic.
Review DTS bindings, driver style, licensing and package submissions.
Publish installation/recovery instructions only for tested variants and methods.
phases.exit_gate: A second clean build and documented repeatable install/recovery validate the milestone.

constraints: No cross-device images or MediaTek flare assumptions
No device changes performed by repository tooling
No invented GPIOs, memory addresses or package checksums
Raw firmware and private device data remain untracked

boot_path.preferred: Custom lithium entry in lk2nd-msm8996, initially installed to recovery after separate review and authorization
boot_path.finding: The MSM8996 target exists. A lithium board-id 38 selector was added and built; existing scorpio images remain incompatible.
boot_path.delivery: Enter lk2nd through recovery while retaining Android boot, then load Linux into RAM through lk2nd Fastboot
boot_path.stock_fastboot: Static stock aboot audit found no registered boot command string; direct fastboot boot is not assumed

host_preflight.note: Tool presence is not version or target compatibility validation.
